subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Discovery follow-up & stakeholder map
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Chen <mark@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference - Discovery follow-up & stakeholder map

Hi Mark — great talking with you this morning. Thanks for walking through Acme's initial use case for customer-facing recommendations. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can map stakeholders and next steps:

- Goal we discussed: integrate a recommendation model into the product to improve click-through and time-to-value for new users.
- Target latency: you mentioned P95 in the ~100–200ms range for single-turn recommendations (512 tokens-ish).
- Cost sensitivity: engineering asked for guidance to keep incremental inference cost under ~$0.01 per inference; willing to trade some latency for lower cost if needed.
- Deployment preference: you said you expect to start with a hosted endpoint but may require a private/VPC deployment for production in Q3.

Could you confirm the following so we can build the mutual action plan?
1) Economic buyer / decision owner (name & title) — who signs off on spend (VP Eng, CTO, procurement)?
2) Security & legal contacts — do you have a security questionnaire contact or procurement contact we should engage?
3) Procurement timeline / contracting path — will this be a PO, SOW, or purchase through your marketplace? Any required terms (data residency, SOC 2, encryption)?
4) SLA requirement — do you need a specific uptime or latency SLA for go-live?

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send a brief stakeholder map template for you to fill (1–2 mins).
- If you confirm the economic buyer, we’ll set up a short pricing alignment with our sales manager and solutions engineer.
- I’ll attach a short playbook summarizing deployment options and SLAs.

Attaching: RWI-deployment-playbook.pdf (summary)

Would you be able to confirm the names/contacts for items 1–3 by end of week? Happy to jump on a 20m call with your security lead if that helps.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(aditya@redwood.ai)
(attachment: RWI-deployment-playbook.pdf)

From: Mark Chen <mark@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:03:42 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Discovery follow-up & stakeholder map

Thanks, Aditya — good conversation. Quick answers below and a few notes from our side:

1) Economic buyer: Laura Bennett, VP of Engineering (laura.bennett@acmeanalytics.com). She owns model spend approvals.
2) Security/legal contact: Procurement handles initial contracts (procurement@acmeanalytics.com). Security questions go to Irene Choi, Head of Security (irene.choi@acmeanalytics.com).
3) Procurement path: We generally either do a PO for SaaS services or an SOW for more complex engagements. For infra-heavy deals we may request a standard SOW + MSAs — procurement can confirm.
4) SLA: For customer-facing recommendations we’d like to target P95 <= 200ms and 99.9% availability for the initial rollout. If hosted endpoints can meet that, fine; otherwise we’ll look at Private (VPC) deployment.

Additional context: Cost is a factor — we’d like to keep cost per inference low enough to run at scale (current internal threshold is roughly <$0.01 per inference). Also need to confirm data residency for EU customers (we'll flag which workloads need EU region).

Happy to fill the stakeholder map — I can do that and loop in Laura and Irene. Can you share a one-pager on SLA commitments and who our contact is to validate SOC 2 evidence?

Best,
Mark
Director of Product 
Acme Analytics

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Chen <mark@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:20:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Discovery follow-up & stakeholder map

Mark — really helpful, thanks for the fast turnaround. I’ve noted Laura (economic buyer) and Irene (security) and will coordinate accordingly. A few concrete items and a proposed mutual action plan below so we can keep momentum: 

Decision criteria clarification (please confirm):
- Latency: P95 <= 200ms for 512-token recommendation calls (single-turn). If you later need multi-turn or longer context we’ll re-evaluate routing and kernels.
- Availability SLA: target 99.9% initially (we can negotiate higher with Dedicated capacity).
- Cost: target < $0.01 per inference at expected Q1–Q2 scale; we’ll model costs across Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private to identify break-even.
- Deployment mode: start with Hosted (fastest), evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity if predictable throughput is required, move to Private/VPC only if procurement/security requires it for production.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) This week: you and Mark to fill the attached stakeholder map template (I’ll re-send as a small form).
2) By EOW: 15–20m pricing alignment with Ben (cc’d) to align on estimate and preferred commercial path (PO vs SOW).
3) Next week: security deep-dive with Irene and our security PM to run through SOC2, data residency, KMS options (we’ll share evidence pack).
4) 2–3 weeks: pilot run (2–4 weeks) on Hosted endpoints with telemetry; measure P95 and cost per inference.

Requested confirmations / asks from your side:
- Confirm Laura and Irene’s willingness to join the short calls above and a preferred time window.
- Any absolute non-starters on terms (data residency, encryption, DPA clauses)?
- Ballpark expected QPS / monthly inferences so we can produce a cost comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated).

I’ve attached a short SLA summary and deployment playbook for your procurement team (SLA-summary.xlsx and RWI-deployment-playbook.pdf). If you’re open, I’ll also prepare a one-page commercial estimate after the pricing alignment call.

Thanks again — I’ll follow up to schedule the Ben pricing sync and security deep-dive once you confirm the stakeholders.

—Aditya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123 | aditya@redwood.ai
(attachment: SLA-summary.xlsx; attachment: RWI-deployment-playbook.pdf)
